imbues.name: Vampiric
imbues.description: Heal 15% of damage dealt on each strike, rounded down
imbues.lore: Soldiers who carried one stopped eating their rations. Nobody asked why.

stone.name: Vampiric Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Warm to the touch, and never for a good reason.

imbues.name: Sundering
imbues.description: Deals 2x effective damage to Armored foes
imbues.lore: Siege-smiths swear by it: plate is only a door nobody has knocked on yet.

stone.name: Sundering Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Chipped off a fortress gate that lost. Price includes the story.

imbues.name: Keen
imbues.lore: The edge hums near a gap in armor, like a dowsing rod near water.

stone.name: Keen Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Hold it by the rim. It already knows where your fingers are soft.

imbues.name: Venomous
imbues.description: Foe loses 5 HP after combat (cannot kill)
imbues.lore: The cut looks clean. It stays that way for about an hour.

stone.name: Venomous Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Kept in wax, handled with tongs, sold with a smile.

imbues.name: Binding
imbues.description: 30% chance to Root the foe for 1 phase after combat
imbues.lore: Struck foes find their boots answering to the ground instead of to them.

stone.name: Binding Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Don't set it down on the counter. The last one took a week to pry up.

imbues.name: Warded
imbues.lore: A chaplain blessed it to defend, and the blade took the word personally.

stone.name: Warded Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Cut from a burned chapel's altar. Hold it to your ear; it's still at vespers.

prismaticStone.name: Prismatic Stone
prismaticStone.lore: Six colors, one stone. Which one wakes is up to your weapon. No returns.
